title: Google’s Demis Hassabis says it’s time for a global AI watchdog — led by the US
slides: Why would DeepMind's Hassabis push for US-led AI oversight?
He warns unchecked labs race without global safety rules.
Hassabis proposes the US, not the UN, sets boundaries.
Your AI tools may soon face mandatory transparency checks.
Compare if your provider shares safety audits by year-end.
thread_text:
1. Why trust the US?

DeepMind's CEO says safety rules should come from Washington, not the UN — a shift from global norms.

2. Labs are racing blind.

No binding global rules exist. Unchecked competition pushes teams to cut corners for speed.

3. Transparency may get teeth.

Mandatory audits for AI tools are being drafted. Your chatbot could face a compliance check next year.

4. The real test is now.

Ask your provider for last year's safety report. If they refuse, you already have your answer.

5. Check your AI vendor today.

Find their safety audit. No public record? Flag it this week before rules force it.
